Multiply by an LDGM Precision Matrix

Source: R/precision.R
ldgm_precision_multiply.Rd

Rcpp-backed sparse matrix multiplication for GraphLD-style precision operators, with OpenMP over multiple right-hand sides when available.

Usage

ldgm_precision_multiply(precision, x)

Arguments

precision

Sparse precision matrix, usually from ldgm_sparse_precision().

x

Numeric vector or matrix.

Value

Numeric vector or matrix containing precision %*% x.
